capathDiagnostic.conclusion: An initially empty get_ca_certs list does not establish missing trust roots; capath loads lazily.

focusedRepair.inference: The eager nonempty get_ca_certs assertion is invalid for capath-only trust. The frozen GNU SDK default paths and actual trust handshake still require native confirmation; missing trust roots are not established by the failed assertion.
focusedRepair.nextRepair: Replace the eager CA-list assertions in check-python.py and check-tls.py with real trust behavior including capath-only coverage; rerun all three native targets without weakening certificate/hostname verification or changing system files.

caValidationRepair.implementation: Removed eager CA enumeration assertions; module diagnostics remain distinct from actual trust handshakes. Added actual capath TLS and explicitly requested unchanged system-store HTTPS verification.
